SwissArmyGrid 1.0.2: charts, Excel export, the Agent tab and agent privacy, tested by trying to break them.

## Install or update

```bash
uv tool install --force "swissarmygrid[server]"   # the server
uv pip install -U swissarmygrid                   # the client, in your project's environment
```

Or the one-line installers from this release (`install.ps1` on Windows, `install.sh` on macOS and Linux).

## Fixed: charts

- **Clicking a date bar** (by day, week, month or year) failed or filtered on a number. It now filters the whole
  time bucket, and a month of a timestamp column keeps its last day.
- Clicking a **line or area** filtered to its first point; a **heatmap** click ignored its row; histogram cards
  said "click to filter" and never did.
- A chart click could **hang forever** once its column had left the view, or save a step that broke the grid.
  Now it answers plainly and adds nothing.
- **Copy as Python (Altair)** failed in a clean Python on any table over 5,000 rows and on column names with
  `:`, `.` or `"`. It now lets DuckDB aggregate first, so the copy runs on any table.
- **Add chart** offered only tables whose tab had been opened. 5,000 bars drew as one black block. "Download as
  HTML" named the wrong table.
- **Diagram cards** could make the browser load an outside link. They can't now.

## Fixed: export

- **Excel export** is almost three times faster: 1,000,000 rows by 10 columns went from 59 s to 22 s, with the
  same file inside.
- Excel silently dropped columns past 16,384 (its limit). Now you are told.
- The export dialog offered a provenance checkbox where it does nothing, and couldn't choose the truncation
  option its own error message suggested.

## Fixed: the Agent tab

- Closing the **approval window** (Esc or X) left the agent waiting 3 minutes. Closing it now declines.
- The **agent activity** list emptied after 200 of your own actions.
- One long value in a result card pushed the other columns off screen.

## Agent privacy

- An export you approve now holds **only what the agent may read** at its level, with the same masks.
- At level 0 the values you type into steps (filter values, SQL text) show to the agent as
  `<hidden at privacy level 0>`. The agent can still add, edit and move steps.
- Level 0 is now truly **numbers only**: the agent can do math on number columns, but can't make a number out of
  a text or date value (a length, a comparison, a sort, a grouping). About 75 such tricks are tested and refused.
- Every one of the 88 agent tools was called at every privacy level with good and hostile arguments. That found
  three ways to crash the server, masking that was too strict on every grid with a step, and error text that
  could quote a hidden column's value. All are fixed.

## Install

- The server install now includes **pandas**, so copied Python is checked exactly as you paste it.
